definitions.explanation: A technique in martial arts, especially judo, sumo, and wrestling, that involves throwing an opponent to the ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{投|な}げ{技|わざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: He won with a splendid throwing technique.

examples.japanese: ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投|な}げ{技|わざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}する→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。

⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{投|な}げ{技|わざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧で、⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{豪快|ごうかい}→豪快：14228_goukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{投|な}げ{飛|と}ばす。
examples.english: That sumo wrestler is good at throwing techniques and powerfully hurls his opponents.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ (to throw) + ⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧ (technique). The ⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧ suffix is used for various martial arts techniques.

USAGE:
Most commonly associated with ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧ (judo) and ⟦{相撲|すもう}→相撲：00390_sumou⟧ (sumo), but also used in professional wrestling and other grappling arts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投|な}げ{技|わざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to apply a throw)
- {投|な}げ{技|わざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧ (an ippon by throw in judo)
- {投|な}げ{技|わざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧ (to be good at throws)
- {大|おお}⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧{刈|が}り (major outer reap — a specific {投|な}げ{技|わざ})

RELATED WORDS:
- {固|かた}め{技|わざ}: grappling/pinning technique
- ⟦{関節|かんせつ}{技|わざ}→関節技：23981_kansetsuwaza⟧: joint lock technique
- {寝技|ねわざ}: ground technique
